comment: A channel's knob is written from the stored value whenever the sequence moves, so the knobs show the current stage rather than a fixed setting (Arrange.cpp:309). While a knob is being dragged the module ignores the matching input for that channel so the drag is not fought (Arrange.cpp:484). The semitone mode rounds to a twelfth of a volt (Arrange.cpp:508), and the trigger mode fires a pulse on each stage change rather than passing any voltage.
